description.value: The mech gains a VI with a tier equal to twice its computer's tier that can function as an operator as long as there is one other operator. Treat its tier as its skill ranks and ¼ its tier as its skill insight bonus for the Maneuver action and similar abilities. At the GM's discretion, this can be used to allow a mech to operate independently. Increase the mech's Will save by 1 for every 10 tiers of the VI. A mech can only have one VI.
